reason: A is the better proposal because substrate preheating plausibly reduces thermal gradients, residual stress, and cracking, with a direct controlled experiment, although its claim that slower cooling necessarily reduces segregation needs qualification. B is mechanistically self-contradictory—higher scan speed generally steepens rather than reduces thermal gradients—and, at fixed laser power, risks lack-of-fusion defects; its evidence from CoCrNi also does not establish the claimed response in AlCrFeNiSi.
